generic_domain.justification: This choice is based on identifying that 'biologically-inspired reinforcement learning' and 'neuroscience-inspired learning' are both specialized subsets of the broader field of reinforcement learning. Reinforcement learning, at its core, is about agents learning optimal behaviors through interactions with an environment to maximize rewards without relying solely on biological or neuroscience principles. These more specific areas focus on incorporating insights from biology and neuroscience into standard reinforcement learning frameworks. Hence, they represent a narrower scope within the larger umbrella of reinforcement learning. Therefore, 'reinforcement learning' serves as the most generic research domain that can encompass all provided options.
